name: Narutodle
summary: Narutodle is a free browser-based daily guessing game set in the Naruto universe. Each day, players try to identify a hidden Naruto character in as few guesses as possible across several modes: Classic, where each guess reveals how the character's attributes (such as gender, affiliation, village, chakra nature and debut arc) compare to the answer; Jutsu, where a technique is shown; Quote, where a line of dialogue is given; and Eye, where a zoomed-in close-up of a character's eyes must be recognized. A new puzzle is released every day for all players, and an Unlimited mode allows endless practice. The game is available in 10 languages.
